evidence: The morphology of the samples were investigated using a Zeiss CrossBeam 340, using electron imaging. The lamellas for transmission electron microscopy (TEM) investigation were prepared using Ga FIB beam milling and lift-out using Kleindiek nanomanipulators to attach the lamellas to conventional Cu TEM half-grids. Transmission electron microscopy characterization: FIB prepared lamellas were investigated using a Tecnai F20 TEM microscope, operated at 200 kV, equipped with Gatan MSC974 CCD camera and EDAX EDS X-ray spectrometer. Atomic force microscopy: The morphology of the samples was investigated in tapping mode by means of an AFM Bruker commercial system, equipped with ultra-sharp silicon probes. Resonant Raman scattering: Resonant Raman spectroscopy measurements were performed in a backscattering configuration employing a Renishaw Invia spectrometer, equipped with the 633 nm (1.96 eV) line of a He-Ne laser.
